newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent trades at low end of recent range.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent trades at low end of recent range.

text.p: Dated Brent traded on Thursday at the equivalent of the lower end of Wednesday's range, traders said.
A Dec 17-19 cargo was sold at Dated Brent evens based on the balance of this week's published quotes, which traders said was equivalent to Jan Brent +35/+40 cents.
The seller bought the cargo at Jan Brent +35 cents on Wednesday. A Dec 19-21 cargo sold later that day for Jan Brent +49 cents to a Wall Street trader collecting barrels for a transatlantic trip.
Two Brent cargoes were due to turn wet on Thursday, traders said.
